messages:
Raj Sinha: Heads up — HavenTech pushed this to their execs. CISO is hung up on KMS/egress and wants HSM-backed keys for the private deployment. Procurement is asking for a 35% trial discount and legal wants SOC2 artifacts before signing. Can we triage? https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/POC-9422
Dan Kaufman: On it. Can everyone hold for a quick sync? I can join an exec bridge tomorrow morning. @Maria can you confirm SSO + on‑prem lead time? @Lina what discount levers do we have short-term?
Maria Chen: SSO status: SAML + SCIM supported in staging, just need the customer metadata and an allowlist for the IdP IPs. On‑prem package: 6 week lead time for full install (air‑gapped needs addtl validation). I can draft a runbook we can share on the call.
Owen Blake: Security note — HavenTech Q12 (crypto attestation) requires KMS attestation + SOC2 report. We have SOC2 Type II report; KMS HSM attestation is available for Private but we need Operations signoff for BYO-KMS. I'll assemble a 1‑page summary for execs.
Lina Gomez: Pricing ops: we can offer a temporary 30% pilot discount if they commit to a minimum $50k trial spend and sign the fast MSA. 35% needs RevOps approval + Dan signoff. Sample (for discussion):
```
Base list: $0.03/token
Pilot (30%): $0.021/token if >= $50k spend
35% requires legal + revops approval
Dedicated pool surcharge: +15% if reserved GPUs
```
Priya Patel: POC infra update: test cluster up, model pinned to v3.2-quant. We hit token timeout at ~200 concurrent connections — looks like batching config needs tuning. Network peering request was opened (#34567) — need approval for inbound from HavenTech CIDR.
Raj Sinha: Customer is pushing for an exec call tomorrow 9:00am ET. @Dan can you take that? Also legal needs to fast-track NDA+MSA — @Lina who owns the fast template?
Lina Gomez: I'll route to RevOps & Legal, cc Dan. Fast MSA template is at https://redwood.internal/templates/fast_msa.pdf. I'll request accelerated review and flag RevOps for the pricing ask.
Dan Kaufman: I can do 9am ET. @Owen please bring the 2-slide security summary + recommended mitigations. @Maria bring options for SSO + on‑prem timeline and fallback configuration. We'll propose conditional 30% pilot as a near-term solution.
DeployBot: deploy:prod:redeploy scheduled 2026-03-20 04:00 UTC — note: brief routing updates may affect private routing tests.
Priya Patel: Ops approved peering; scheduled tonight 23:00 UTC. We'll validate after and post results here. Only port 443 open for the peer.
Owen Blake: Sharing quick checklist snippet for the call:
```
- SOC2 Type II: available (attach)
- KMS: HSM attestation required -> Private supports, Hosted needs BYO-KMS discussion
- Network: peering approved by Ops? (pending)
- SSO: metadata needed from HavenTech
```
Raj Sinha: Thanks all — I'll send the invite and a short agenda for the 9am ET exec bridge. If anyone hits a blocker, ping me before 8pm PT so I can update the customer. :thumbsup:
